summary: Iteration 5 testing complete. Added /app/backend/tests/test_fishing.py (3 new tests: credit + caught fields with strict bell increase, island-only gate, actor-scoped). All 28 backend tests pass (regressions: economy/farming, decor/rotation, houses/zones). Frontend E2E verified: walking into Nook Shop auto-opens shop modal, 'Today's Furniture' shows exactly 2 rotating items, seed purchase deducts bells (120->112), shop-close works, no top-bar shop-button, Fish button is dim 'Fish' off-water (toast asks for pond) and becomes highlighted 'Cast Line!' near pond; clicking it caught a Sea Bass and bells increased 120->142. Clock badge shows 'Morning' and updates. Town renders roads, Nook Shop/Museum/Cafe buildings, ponds and trees.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is approaching 500 lines mixing REST, WS, economy & fishing handlers; consider splitting WS message handlers into a dispatch dict / separate modules for maintainability.

fish handler returns a 'wallet' message with extra 'caught'/'caught_value' fields; frontend relies on message.type==='wallet' + optional caught; acceptable but a dedicated 'fish_catch' type would be cleaner and avoid overloading wallet semantics.

No server-side proximity check for fishing — only zone==island is enforced. Not a bug per spec (client restricts via nearWater), but a determined client could spam /fish regardless of location. Low risk given multiplayer trust model.
seed_data_creation: Rooms created with prefix TEST_Fish / TEST_Econ during tests; stale rooms harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fishing works via WS {type:'fish'} returning wallet payload with caught/caught_value when on island. Ponds at (560,980), (1520,1050), (320,300); Shop building at (1000,430). Spawn (1000,750). SPEED=4.3. Shop auto-opens when player's x within 48 of shop.x and y in (shop.y-10, shop.y+80). Playwright: hold keys with keyboard.down/up with ~1.5-2s waits to traverse ~400px. test_fishing.py covers key fish behaviours.
